title: Finite-time blow-up in an elementary model of the 3D Navier-Stokes equations
summary: We demonstrate finite-time blow-up in a simple, realistic shell model of the 3D Navier-Stokes equations, equipped with "smooth" (i.e., rapidly decaying in frequency) initial data and forcing. Previously studied models either exhibit a turbulent cascade that regularizes the three-dimensional viscous dynamics, or rely on highly artificial interactions not transparently realized in the true Euler nonlinearity.
